owner_design_statement: Project-Frankenstein mechanisms were predominantly derived from first-principles/logical reasoning with emergent coupling as the architecture substrate; preserve original functional logic before mapping to conventional categories.
completion_definition: Exhaustively reconstruct all material mechanism families, their lineage, successes, failures, equations, coupling topology, timing, state persistence, experiments, papers, originality/prior-art status and current reuse implications.

A-01-HISTORY-TIMELINE.goal: Chronological architecture/version timeline from commit history and release docs.

A-02-MECHANISM-INVENTORY.goal: Enumerate all material modules/mechanisms/aliases and first known versions.

A-03-COUPLING-GRAPH.goal: Reconstruct cross-module recurrent coupling graph with timescales and state variables.

A-04-FAILURE-ATLAS.goal: Extract bugs, regressions, negative results, ordering failures and root causes.

A-05-SUCCESS-ATLAS.goal: Extract measured/reported successful mechanisms and reusable invariants.

A-06-GWT-LINEAGE.goal: Trace workspace/attention/broadcast/reentry mechanisms and mathematics across versions.

A-07-PERSONALITY-SELF.goal: Trace E-PQ, ego/body, self-knowledge, goals, reward and identity machinery.

A-09-LORA-LINEAGE.goal: Trace all LoRA generations, SOMA, training targets, failures and measured deltas.

A-10-BOOT-STATE.goal: Trace boot order, service lifecycle, snapshot/restart/recovery/state persistence sensitivities.

A-11-PAPERS.goal: Read and connect all papers/research notes to implemented mechanisms and evidence.

A-12-ORIGINALITY.goal: Prior-art queue and careful originality classification after native mechanism reconstruction.

A-13-CURRENT-INHERITANCE.goal: Map each current FRANK/Harness/ClayCode component to reuse/adapt/retest/reject decisions.
